latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of jike-publisher skill.

- Publish posts to Jike (即刻) using browser automation—no API key required.
- Supports text posts with emoji, hashtags, topics, and links.
- Operates via managed browser profile (“openclaw”) with active Jike login session.
- Includes guides for posting workflows, Unicode escaping (for Chinese text), and troubleshooting.
- Automatically records publish history to local JSON state file for state tracking.
